title: ST4 migration read-only review verdict
description: Verdict returned by the read-only st4-reviewer subagent. The controller requires approved=true AND deterministic green gates before committing; self-reported worker success is never sufficient.

approved.description: true only if the diff is a faithful single-slice migration that obeys the architecture principle and does not grow debt.

singleSlice.description: true if the diff touches only the assigned item (no unrelated/while-youre-here changes).

debtGrew.description: true if a new direct backend or other debt was introduced.

issues.description: Concrete file:line problems; empty when approved.
